notes.title: Version 1.0.11 (Hard mode bug fix)
notes.notes:
Minor bug fixes and fixed a hard mode bug that would not allow hard mode to be turned off.
This fix may effect older saves in saying that hard mode is off when it's not and vise versa.
To check if you have this issue, have Locke use bestiary on a monster. If it's Hp ends in a 0 or 5 you are most likely on normal mode. If it doesn't than you are likely in hard mode. To fix it toggle hard mode once and check an enemies HP again. Again, the selected mode may be the opposite of what you've selected.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bolder in the geyser planes that cause the shortcut to not work.
-Fixed post game sequence to work properly after a reload.
-Fixed stray events that were unused or invisible.
-Fixed event sequencing that would cause visiting some old areas to have a black screen and never fade in.
-Fixed transfer sequence on a tile on a path north of Drasil causing you to go to the wrong area.
-Fixed certain dialogue on directing the player on where to go.
-Fixed Spelling of certain area's to all be consistant.
-Fixed Ruins side quest from being repeatable.
-Various bugs fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue that would cause the credits not to play if Evelyne had the highest affection points.
-Fixed an issue that caused some attack skills to be used in the menu.
-Fixed an issue that allowed some options not to be saved in the option menu.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 bug fix
notes.notes:
-Pathing on being pushed back in the lowest map transition tile from Fallenberg crossroad to the mountain pass has been fixed.
- Fixed sequence breaking when going to the west part of the mythical Forrest (where you exit the 3rd dungeon) before going to the sluice.
-Fixed area in Sluice where you can get stuck if you did not drain the water.
-Fixed scripting event in Prison where event triggers were not set properly causing a black screen.
-Fixed game breaking bug when attempting to revisit the plains east of Drasil / west of Spia after critical game event. (added minor item to grab)
-Fixed duplicate quest item in sluice,
-replaced with blood Edge which was found in the same dungeon
-replaced blood Edge with Hoplite. a new spear for Locke. Up's Def and Mag at cost of atk.
-Fixed event triggering preventing you from reentering the prison area.
-Due to these changes and the limitation of the save engine. if you already opened these chests they may already be opened and unobtainable upon game update. The hoplite is not a huge issue if missed. The blood edge can open up new strategies so a extra one is available in the inner depths of the steam dungeon if you do not have one in your inventory.

-Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Upcomming release
notes.notes:
Banbard is set for release this Monday. I've very excited to share my passion project with the world. It's something I've been working on daily for the past three years. It's a great feeling of pride and relief now that the bulk of the project is done. 
I'm sure that there will be new bugs found once this is released, and I'll be sure to work on anything that needs fixing during release week. 

Stay tuned,
Hoboayoyo

notes.title: Banbard Slight Delay
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,
A quick update to talk about a slight delay for Banbard's release for those who haven't gotten the update email.
Going over the dialogue and script for the game, I noticed some grammar and spelling errors.
I want to make sure this game is in the best possible condition for release. So I'm having some people go over the entirety of the game's script again to make sure everything is in tip-top shape for release. This also allows me to make some last-minute tweaks to some sections of the game and tighten it up.

Thanks for your understanding.
Hoboayoyo
